items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Snack had a tremendous idea about musicianship. He was strict. He was very much like Mr. Langford.

ctx.x: Well, did the people dance at this ball?

Well, no, I'll tell you what happened. The August Moon Ball is for the people from the different ideas of dance there and these were cats who would dance the waltz, you know, and the cats who would do cats who would dance the tango and the dance this kind of thing and out of that came a group called Whitey and his Lindy Hoppers. So we played for the Lindy hoppers, and Abe Lyman played for the waltzers and we played the tango and all that kind of thing. It was a very enjoyable thing. Those pictures I can't find…
